description: Expanding an Indigenous Environmental Monitoring Network: Community-driven Stewardship of Land and Water is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Indigenous Sentinel Network. The network connects Indigenous and Western science through monitoring software used by Indigenous communities across Alaska and beyond. ISN History The Indigenous Sentinels Network (ISN) is a Tribally governed environmental monitoring system that integrates Indigenous knowledge, community priorities, and climate data to support local decision-making. Coverage: St. Paul Island, AK (2025). The toolkit gives St. Paul Island, AK as the location, 2025 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
